<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="21" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
  <line x1="321" y1="17" x2="321" y2="21" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="14" x2="326" y2="21" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="11" x2="331" y2="21" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="344" cy="17" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="22" x2="347" y2="22" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="358" y="11" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="14" width="15" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <rect x="381" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,59 23,67 31,75" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="67" x2="39" y2="67" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="73" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Profile setup</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <text x="195" y="139" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Add a profile picture</text>
  <text x="195" y="169" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Help your community recognize you</text>

  <!-- Avatar shadow and avatar -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="287" r="96" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="284" r="92" fill="#D4FCBC" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="260" r="27" fill="#5DB075"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="326" rx="55" ry="35" fill="#5DB075"/>
  <text x="195" y="294" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">AM</text>

  <!-- Camera action -->
  <circle cx="264" cy="348" r="29" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
  <circle cx="264" cy="345" r="29" fill="#5DB329" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4"/>
  <rect x="251" y="337" width="26" height="17" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="256" y="333" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="264" cy="345" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="273" cy="340" r="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>

  <!-- Supporting card -->
  <rect x="29" y="405" width="332" height="88" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect x="29" y="403" width="332" height="88" rx="10" fill="#F3FAF6" stroke="#D4FCBC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="435" r="15" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <polyline points="50,435 55,440 64,430" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="83" y="434" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Make it yours</text>
  <text x="83" y="458" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Use a clear photo so friends can find you.</text>

  <!-- Buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="35" y="526" width="320" height="60" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="35" y="524" width="320" height="60" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="562" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">UPDATE</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="35" y="603" width="320" height="60" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="641" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">LATER</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="762" width="390" height="82" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="762" x2="390" y2="762" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,789 48,781 58,789" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="41" y="788" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Home</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Explore -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="126" cy="790" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="797" x2="138" y2="803" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="126" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Community -->
  <g>
    <rect x="193" y="782" width="18" height="13" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="197,795 197,800 202,795" fill="#999999"/>
    <circle cx="198" cy="788" r="1" fill="#999999"/>
    <circle cx="202" cy="788" r="1" fill="#999999"/>
    <circle cx="206" cy="788" r="1" fill="#999999"/>
    <text x="202" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Community</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Profile active -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="331" cy="787" r="6" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <ellipse cx="331" cy="801" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="331" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
